pulls.title: ci: pin runs-on to ubuntu-24.04 before ubuntu-latest moves to Ubuntu 26.04
pulls.author: tyche-dev
pulls.body:
GitHub moves the `ubuntu-latest` label to the Ubuntu 26.04 image between 19 October and 19 November 2026 ([actions/runner-images#14748](https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/14748)). This PR pins the jobs below to `ubuntu-24.04`, the image `ubuntu-latest` resolves to today, so nothing changes in what runs. Ubuntu 24.04 stays supported for about two more years.

**Why these jobs.** Datatracker upload on `draft-*` tags. The i-d-template action runs in its own container, so the risk is small, but the IETF Internet-Draft cutoff on 2 November 2026 falls inside the migration window.

**Changed** (only `runs-on: ubuntu-latest` lines):
- `.github/workflows/publish.yml`: 1 line(s) -> ubuntu-24.04

**Merging.** Merging runs the editor's-copy build as on any push.
